solves: Leads the person to a page, or opens a group of pages, in a first-level line of the lateral menu, with the current page marked and, when needed, a counter, the full name in a balloon and a shortcut to the actions of the item.
use_when: With type link, to lead to a product page.
With counter, when the page has something to look at, such as new messages or tasks.
With type group, to gather pages of the same subject under an item that opens and closes.
With tooltip, when the label can be cut, to show the full name.
With more actions, as a shortcut of the item actions for mouse and keyboard, always with the same actions on the destination page.
Disabled, when the page exists but the person has no access now.
do_not_use_when: As an action button, such as save or delete: use nph-button.
As a group for one page only: use type link.
To choose an option or open actions in a menu: use nph-dropdown-menu.
To organize the navigation inside the content: use nph-panel-menu.
With text in the counter: the counter shows a number only; for a short label, use nph-badge.
With more actions as the only path to an action: on touch it does not appear.

type.constraint: link leads to a page through href; group opens and closes the subitems below it, through expanded. The Figma counter type is a link with counter; group-closed and group-open are group with expanded off and on. Reflects because the CSS reads it. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

label.constraint: The text of the line, already localized: one line, with an ellipsis when it does not fit. It is the accessible name. Empty is a mount: nothing is drawn and no error is emitted.

icon.constraint: A core name of nph-icon, drawn at icon/size-md: light at rest, solid when active or in an open group. Empty or outside the core draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

href.constraint: The page the link leads to. Required in a link that is not disabled; a group has none. A link without href, or a group with href, draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

active.constraint: The current page: the link takes aria-current="page". Only one item of the menu is active. It does not exist in a group: an active group draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

expanded.constraint: The group is open: aria-expanded, the arrow up and the solid icon. Only in a group. The person toggles it with a click, Enter or Space.

counter.constraint: A whole number from zero up, the pending items of the page, in a pill after the label. Only in a link. A number that is not whole, a negative one or text draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

disabled.constraint: The page exists, but the person has no access now: the line at state/disabled-opacity, out of the Tab order, with no click, no balloon and no more actions. A disabled link needs no href.

tooltip.constraint: The text of the nph-tooltip with the full name, on hover and focus, already localized. It does not follow label: whoever uses it edits both. Empty turns it off.

actions.constraint: The entries of the nph-dropdown-menu that more actions opens, as data (property only), in the shape of the items of nph-dropdown-menu. Empty turns more actions off.

actions-label.constraint: The accessible name of the more actions button, already localized. Required with actions: without it, the item draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

nph-toggle.constraint: Fired when the person opens or closes a group, with detail.expanded, the new state. It bubbles, crosses shadow roots and is not cancelable. Setting expanded from code fires nothing.

nph-item-select.constraint: The action the person chose in the menu of more actions, fired again on the host with the detail of nph-dropdown-menu (value and checked). It bubbles.

type.choose_when: link to lead to a page; link with counter when the page has something to look at; group to gather pages of the same subject.
do_not_combine_with: group with href, counter or active.

tooltip.choose_when: When the label can be cut: the balloon shows the full name.
do_not_combine_with: disabled: a disabled line has no balloon.

more-actions.choose_when: When the item has actions of its own, also offered on the destination page.
do_not_combine_with: disabled: a disabled line has no more actions.

rest.changes_for_user: No background: the line shows the panel. The label in text/body-md and the light icon in sidebar/item-foreground.

hover.changes_for_user: The whole line in sidebar/item-background-hover, the more actions button included; the colors of rest.

active.changes_for_user: The current page: no background, the label and the solid icon in sidebar/item-foreground-active, the label in text/label-md.

open.changes_for_user: The open group: the label and the solid icon in sidebar/item-foreground-open, the label in text/label-md and the arrow up.

focus.changes_for_user: Keyboard focus: border border/width in color/primary and halo focus/ring-width in focus/halo around the whole line, outside it.

disabled.changes_for_user: The whole line at state/disabled-opacity, with no hover; it cannot be reached by Tab.

business_rules: Only the current page is active, and a group is never active.
The group toggles expanded by itself on a click, Enter or Space, and fires nph-toggle; the menu shows or hides the subitems.
The counter shows a whole number only, read inside the name of the link.
More actions appears on hover and focus, for mouse and keyboard only; on touch it does not appear.
A click on more actions, on its menu or on the balloon is not a click on the line: it stops at the host.

tokens.label: text/body-md in sidebar/item-foreground; text/label-md when active or in an open group
tokens.icon: nph-icon icon/size-md, light; solid when active or in an open group
tokens.arrow: nph-icon icon/size-sm: chevron-down closed, chevron-up open
tokens.counter: text/label-sm in sidebar/item-badge-foreground on sidebar/item-badge-background, icon/size-md high, space/inline on the sides, radius/full
tokens.more_actions: nph-button icon-only, ghost and compact, with ellipsis-vertical, sidebar/item-padding from the end
tokens.focus: border border/width in color/primary, focus/border-radius-sidebar-item; halo focus/ring-width in focus/halo, focus/radius-sidebar-item

ai_hints: Use nph-sidebar-item for a line of the lateral menu; for an action, use nph-button.
Mark only the current page as active; mark the group of the current page open, never active.
Use type group only when it holds two or more pages; a single page is a link.
Turn on tooltip when the label can be cut, with the full name.
Give more actions only actions that the destination page also offers.
In the collapsed menu, use nph-sidebar-rail-button; inside an open group, use nph-sidebar-subitem.

accessibility.semantics: A link with aria-current=page on the current page; a group is a button with aria-expanded. Disabled, the link has no href, keeps role link and gains aria-disabled.
accessibility.accessible_name: The label; the counter number is read as text inside the name of the link. The icon and the arrow are hidden from the screen reader. The more actions button is named by actions-label, and the balloon is the description of the line.
keyboard: Tab: reaches the line and then, when there is one, the more actions button; Shift+Tab comes back.
Enter and Space: open and close a group.
accessibility.focus: Border color/primary and halo focus/halo around the whole line, keyboard only, as in nph-button.
accessibility.contrast: Label, number and icon pass 4.5:1 and 3:1 against the line background, sidebar/panel-background at rest and focus and sidebar/item-background-hover on hover, and the number against sidebar/item-badge-background, in both modes; the focus border passes 3:1 against sidebar/panel-background. Disabled is exempt.
accessibility.color_alternative: Active also switches the icon to solid and the label to text/label-md; an open group shows the arrow up; the counter carries the number as text.

invalid_combinations: A type outside link and group — the item draws nothing.
An icon empty or outside the core — the item draws nothing.
A link without href, unless disabled — it leads nowhere.
A group with href, counter or active — a group opens subitems and is never the current page.
A counter that is not a whole number from zero up — the counter shows a number only.
actions without actions-label — the button would have no name.
anti_patterns: Using the item as an action button, such as save or delete.
Using a group for one page only.
Leaving a long label without tooltip.
Relying on more actions as the only path to an action.
Using the item to choose an option or open actions in a menu.

sources.design_md: design.md, color/primary, focus/halo, focus/ring-width, border/width, space/control-padding, space/inline, icon/size-md, icon/size-sm, radius/full, text/body-md, text/label-md, text/label-sm and state/disabled-opacity; the sidebar/* tokens and the focus radii are in src/tokens/source/semantic.tokens.json
